name: Mjolnir
notes: Version 1.0.1 requires OS X 10.12 or higher plus Lua and LuaRocks; functionality comes from separately installed modules such as mjolnir.hotkey and mjolnir.application, and window control needs accessibility access.
summary: A macOS app that loads a Lua environment where user configs and LuaRocks modules bind global hotkeys, show alerts, and inspect or move running applications and windows.
